blocks.raw: <Tip>**Joint and several liability** means each partner can be held personally liable for the full amount of a claim, not just their proportional share. A client may pursue any single partner for the entire loss, leaving that partner to seek contribution from the others.</Tip>

blocks.raw: <ExamTip>Partnership dissolution is a common LEA topic. Key triggers: agreement of all partners, death of a partner, incapacity, or breach of partnership terms. After dissolution, the remaining partners must check whether they still meet the 75% RLA requirement before continuing practice.</ExamTip>
